propositions: A nested `bridge` CLI command group must register only `preview` (read-only, forces dry-run) and `sync` (mutating, forces live) subcommands while preserving legacy top-level spellings (reconcile, jira-onboard, bridge-probe, bridge-fsck).
The bridge command group must reject `--mode`, `--filter-local-ids`, and trailing arguments to prevent callers from overriding the read/write distinction.
Bridge preview must perform zero Jira writes and zero ticket or bridge-state writes, proven by exact snapshots.
Bridge sync must perform persisted mutations from a production-shaped fake Jira fixture while preserving unrelated event state.
Help text for bridge, preview, and sync subcommands must exclude internal vocabulary (mode, rank, gate, lock, cap, pass, binding store) and numeric exit-code values.
Unknown nested verbs must fail with valid choices listed and never dispatch a same-named top-level command.
